pure-announcement.rationale: An evergreen product docs landing page, not a launch, release note or funding post, though it reads as marketing.

duplicate.rationale: proxy-boundary-session-capture covers crash-resilient recording for session recovery, not a managed gateway's analytics/caching/rate-limiting/fallback control plane; the other nearest concepts are MCP-governance notes.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Each capability claim links to its own feature documentation where it can be verified.

durability.rationale: It is a vendor feature list ('analytics, caching, rate limiting, model fallback', 'one line of code', 'available on all plans') — exactly the matrix-and-pitch content that dates, with no mechanism behind it.

actionability.rationale: It sketches what an AI gateway buys you but gives no steps, trade-offs or decision criteria — a landscape description that ends in navigation cards.

atomicity.rationale: One idea — a gateway between app and model providers centralizes observability and control — stateable in a paragraph; the Workers AI and Discord cards are page chrome, not extra ideas.
